name: drawio
description: Draw.io diagram skill - generate .drawio XML and export to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG

kuraxii.overview: Create diagrams, flowcharts, architecture diagrams, UML, SysML/MBSE, BPMN, network topology, cloud architecture, ML/DL figures, mind maps. Generates .drawio XML and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG via draw.io desktop CLI.
